svg.title: Resize a shape and table with separate axis ratios
svg.desc: Reopened slide renders show an ellipse and a two-column table before and after changing to A4. The summaries give saved shape dimensions, table position, column widths, minimum row heights and unchanged font sizes.

g.text: Width ratio 1.083 scales X and widths.
Height ratio 1.333 scales Y and heights.
Font sizes stay fixed · Shape 28 pt · Table cells 24 pt
